Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api

Interface CozyVoiceApi

public interface CozyVoiceApi
Entry point of the Cozy Voice Chat addon API.

Get the instance with get() at any time after mod construction (for example in FMLCommonSetupEvent, a server event or a client tick). Everything else is reached from it:

  • server(): queries and actions on the logical server (mutes, effects, groups, custom audio channels);
  • client(): the local client (talking state, levels, local mute/deafen);
  • createEncoder() / createDecoder(): the Opus codec used by the mod.

Events are regular Forge events posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS; see the net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event packages.

If Cozy Voice Chat is an optional dependency, guard calls with ModList.get().isLoaded(CozyVoiceApi.MOD_ID) or isAvailable().

Thread safety: get() and the codec factories may be called from any thread. Server methods are thread-safe; client setters must run on the client thread (see ClientVoiceApi).

Before 1.1.0 this was a final class with only the static route-hook methods; those are still here and work the same.

Since:
1.0.0
